jobs.title: Platform
jobs.description: Skip to main content Join us at AUSA and meet the SHIFTERS team. OCTOBER 12–15 Meet us at AUSA Autonomous robotic teams Designed for dangerous ground missions. Shifters develops and enables teams of robots to move autonomously through complex terrain — carrying sensors or payloads into dangerous environments where humans shouldn't go. Get in Touch Learn More ROBOTS GO FIRST. Shifters builds autonomous robotic systems for missions where access is hard, conditions are unpredictable, and human exposure should be reduced. We are developing AI-native platforms that help robotic teams move, coordinate, and act in hazardous environments with greater speed, consistency, and resilience. PLATFORM A layered robotics stack for coordinated autonomous ground operations. Shifters is building an integrated platform spanning AI decision-making, mission orchestration, and robotic systems designed for real-world deployment. RITA ROBOT INTENT TO ACTION A specialized AI brain and command layer that helps robotic systems interpret intent, adapt to changing conditions, and execute autonomous tasks with confidence. TRUST TACTICAL ROBOT FOR UNMANNED SAFETY & SECURITY TASKS A family of rugged robotic platforms for dangerous ground missions, starting with quadruped systems for maneuverability and modularity. ARENA AUTONOMOUS ROBOTIC EXECUTION AND NEXUS ARCHITECTURE Mission orchestration and coordination enabling robotic teams with diverse capabilities to execute synchronized operations across complex missions. SKILLS Mission ready. Adaptable by design. Our robotic platform is built on a foundation of trust — engineered for reliability in the world's toughest environments. Layer on the skills you need. Change them as the mission evolves. Always ready. Always relevant. MODULAR PAYLOADS. ENDLESS POSSIBILITIES. ISR PAYLOAD Advanced imaging and intelligence gathering. MANIPULATOR Precision handling and task execution. MESH NODE Secure, resilient communications in any environment. MISSION READY. Adaptable by design APPLICATIONS Built for dangerous environments where access, awareness, and coordination matter. Shifters develops autonomous robotic systems designed to reduce human exposure and extend operational reach in complex ground environments. Our platforms support sensing, maneuverability, and coordinated robotic action across a wide range of demanding missions. Building Entry and Interior Scanning Robotic teams entering complex structures to map, scan, and build situational awareness before people move in. Perimeter and Site Security Autonomous robots helping monitor large sites, critical areas, and exposed perimeters with greater persistence and lower human exposure. Hazardous Area Reconnaissance Sending robotic systems into dangerous or degraded environments to gather information, carry sensors, and extend visibility. Subterranean and GPS-Denied Navigation Operating in tunnels, enclosed spaces, and navigation-challenged environments where mobility, autonomy, and coordination matter. Emergency and Critical Response Supporting time-sensitive response in dangerous environments where robotic access can improve speed, awareness, and safety. Industrial and Infrastructure Inspection Adapting robotic platforms for inspection and sensing tasks in complex built environments where access is difficult or conditions are hazardous. ADDITIONAL APPLICATIONS Modular payload integration, remote sensing, construction support, industrial inspection, and mission-specific adaptation. TEAM Built by a multidisciplinary team spanning AI, software, robotics, mechatronics, production and operation. Shifters brings together expertise across AI autonomy, software, robotic systems, prototyping, and manufacturing to build systems that can move from concept to deployment. We believe advanced robotics should be both technically ambitious and operationally practical — designed not just to demo well, but to perform where it matters. Meet the Team Join Our Team WHY SHIFTERS Robotic teams can go where people shouldn't. Many high-risk operations still depend on direct human presence in environments that are difficult to access, difficult to understand, and difficult to control. Shifters is building coordinated robotic systems to help reduce that exposure — extending reach, improving situational awareness, and enabling action in places where time, terrain, and danger matter. OUR APPROACH Built for the real world, not for the lab. AI-native from the start Autonomy is built into the system from the beginning, not added on later. Coordinated robotic teams We design for multiple robotic systems working together, not just one robot at a time. Rugged maneuverability Our systems are built to move through complex terrain and difficult physical environments. Practical deployment We focus on systems that are scalable, fieldable, and designed for real operational use. Modular architecture Our platform is designed to support different payloads, mission profiles, and integration needs over time. Trusted and secure systems Built to meet the highest standards of safety, reliability, and system integrity. Building the next generation of autonomous ground robotics. Get in touch to learn more about Shifters, our platform, and upcoming capabilities. Contact Us

jobs.title: AI Embedded Engineer
jobs.description: Share this job Description Robotics | Edge AI | Deployment & Optimization About the Role We’re looking for a Mid–Senior Embedded AI Engineer to help deploy and optimize AI models on a custom robot platform. You’ll work closely with the AI and embedded software teams to take trained RL policies, vision models, and LLM components and make them run reliably, efficiently, and in real time on Jetson-based onboard compute. If you enjoy squeezing performance out of edge hardware and making advanced models work on real robots, this role is for you. What You’ll Do • Deploy RL policies, vision models, and LLM components onto Jetson-based edge devices • Optimize inference performance (latency, memory, power) using TensorRT and related tooling • Integrate AI models into ROS2-based robotic systems • Build and maintain deployment pipelines using Docker • Debug and optimize AI workloads running fully onboard the robot • Collaborate closely with AI researchers and embedded software engineers to bridge research and production What We’re Looking For • Mid–Senior level experience in embedded or edge AI systems • Strong C++ or Python • Experience with ROS2 • Hands-on experience with TensorRT/ONNX and model optimization • Experience deploying ML models on NVIDIA Jetson platforms • Comfortable working with Docker in production systems • Strong systems mindset and attention to performance and reliability Nice to Have • Experience deploying RL policies on robots • Familiarity with vision models or multimodal systems • Prior work on real-time or safety-critical robotic systems Why Join • Work on a custom, real-world robot • See your work directly affect robot behavior in the real world • Fast-paced Series A environment with high ownership and impact • Fully onboard compute — no “cloud-only” robotics demos here Apply for this job This website uses cookies to improve user’s experience, personalise ads and analyse traffic. jobs.title: AI Engineer - Foundational Vision & Language Models for Robotics
jobs.description: Share this job Description Mid–Senior | Robotics | Applied Research & Deployment We are hiring a Mid–Senior AI Engineer to join our AI team and work on large language, vision-language, and vision-language-action models for robotic autonomy. This role will focus on improving the robot’s reasoning, planning, and autonomous decision-making capabilities using modern foundational AI models. You will collaborate closely with the AI, robotics, and embedded software teams to build intelligent robotic capabilities end to end — from model development and evaluation to integration and deployment on real robots with onboard compute. What You’ll Do Design, develop, and deploy LLM-, VLM-, and VLA-based systems for robotic reasoning, planning, perception, and action. Build agentic and multi-agent systems for robotic decision-making and task execution. Develop human–robot interaction capabilities using language, vision, and multimodal inputs. Fine-tune, adapt, evaluate, and deploy foundation models for real-world robotic use cases. Integrate AI models with perception, navigation, control, and ROS-based robotic systems. Work on model deployment for fully onboard and hybrid edge/cloud compute scenarios. Build evaluation pipelines for robot autonomy, model behavior, task success, reliability, and safety. Collaborate with embedded software and robotics engineers to connect high-level AI systems with real-time robot execution. Translate research ideas into practical, robust systems that operate on physical robots. Requirements Strong background in Python, machine learning, deep learning, and applied AI development. Hands-on experience working with LLMs, VLMs, multimodal models, or foundation model pipelines. Experience with model fine-tuning, prompting, evaluation, inference optimization, or deployment. Familiarity with agent frameworks, tool-using models, planning systems, or similar architectures. Strong understanding of modern AI model development workflows, including data preparation, training, evaluation, and deployment. Ability to work across software boundaries, from research code to production-quality robotic systems. Strong systems thinking and the ability to reason about end-to-end autonomy pipelines. Experience debugging complex AI systems in real-world or simulated environments. Apply for this job This website uses cookies to improve user’s experience, personalise ads and analyse traffic. jobs.title: Reinforcement Learning Algorithms Engineer
jobs.description: Share this job Description Shifters is looking for a Reinforcement Learning Algorithms Engineer to develop and deploy advanced whole-body control policies for our autonomous quadruped robots. You will train robust behaviors for dynamic locomotion, balance, recovery, manipulation, and coordinated loco-manipulation tasks using large-scale physics simulation. The role includes reward and curriculum design, motion imitation, sim-to-real transfer, and close collaboration with robotics, mechatronics, and embedded teams to validate policies on real hardware. Requirements Strong Python programming skills. Practical experience with reinforcement learning, including policy-gradient methods such as PPO. Experience developing, training, and evaluating algorithms in simulation. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team. Experience with computer vision, ROS 2, robotics, or embedded computing platforms is an advantage. Experience deploying algorithms on physical robotic systems is a strong advantage. jobs.title: Accessibility
jobs.description: Skip to main content Accessibility Statement Last updated: June 4, 2026 Our Commitment Shifters is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We continually work to improve the user experience for everyone and apply the relevant accessibility standards. Conformance Status The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) define requirements for designers and developers to improve accessibility for people with disabilities. The Shifters website aims to conform with WCAG 2.1 Level AA and is designed to align with Section 508 of the U.S. Rehabilitation Act. Accessibility Features Semantic HTML landmarks (header, nav, main, footer) Skip-to-content link on every page Visible keyboard focus indicators on all interactive elements Descriptive labels on form fields and icon-only controls Alt text on meaningful images; decorative media marked aria-hidden Respect for the operating system "reduce motion" preference Color contrast meeting WCAG AA for body text Responsive layout supporting 320px viewports and 200% zoom Known Limitations Some background videos used for visual atmosphere are presented without captions because they contain no spoken content. The full UGV scenario video on the dedicated page is in the process of having an open-caption track added. Feedback We welcome feedback on the accessibility of the Shifters website. If you encounter accessibility barriers or need information in an alternative format, please contact us at info@shiftersai.com. We aim to respond within 5 business days.
